legs.title: Calgary ⇄ Manila (round trip)
legs.note: Air Canada via Edmonton and Vancouver, then Philippine Airlines overnight to Manila. Home on PR 116 through Vancouver.

fit.why: leaves time for the morning flight to Panglao

returnFit.why: you fly in from Coron and ride from Clark that day

legs.title: Manila → Bohol-Panglao
legs.note: Separate ticket. Allow time to move from the international terminal to the domestic one.

fit.why: time to clear immigration and change terminals

estimate.source: Live check Oct 11 2026: C$108 for Cebu Pacific 09:50

legs.title: Bohol → El Nido
legs.note: One way, nonstop on Cebgo, landing late afternoon. It only runs some days of the week, so the plan is built around this flight.

fit.why: check out of Panglao in the morning

estimate.source: Live check Oct 11 2026: C$209 on Thu Nov 19

legs.title: El Nido → Coron fast ferry
legs.note: About 3–4 hrs. Check in at El Nido port an hour before and bring a printed ticket.

estimate.source: Jonny Melon El Nido–Coron guide: Phimal ₱3,175, Montenegro ₱3,290

legs.title: Coron → Clark
legs.note: Separate ticket. Several nonstops a day, so a later one still makes the evening flight home if the first is delayed.

fit.why: 2–3 hrs by bus to Manila airport, then 3 hrs before the 21:05 flight

estimate.source: Live check Oct 11 2026: C$80–154 on Dec 1

legs.title: Clark → Manila airport (bus)
legs.note: Genesis P2P bus from Clark Airport to NAIA, 2–3 hrs depending on traffic. A private car or Grab is faster and costs more.

legs.title: Coron → Manila (via Cebu)
legs.note: One ticket through Cebu, landing right at Manila airport. If the first flight is late, the airline rebooks the second.

fit.why: land at least 3 hrs before the 21:05 flight home

estimate.source: Live check Oct 11 2026: C$228–268 on Nov 29
